notes: Warm-cache observations on a shared Apple M1 Ultra Mac using Git 2.56.1; three paired rounds per workload/backend/environment. These are not cold-cache results, load-saturation tests or universal speed guarantees.

The headline runs contain 282 verified measured creates with zero failures, independently checking raw bytes, executable modes, symlink targets, native Twig selection and source isolation after private writes. Warmups are additional and not counted as measured creates.

Workers starter and the historical git-twig workload each create ten worktrees sequentially. Axo, Linux kernel, OpenClaw and Pulumi docs each create one worktree per cohort. This refresh targets sequential creation latency after the verifier optimization, not the archived campaign's 100-way throughput. Counts and environments differ; do not compare absolute row times as identical operations.

Host-APFS timing and isolated case-sensitive APFS allocation use separate runs with identical pinned input revisions and candidate binary. Kernel time and allocation both come from case-sensitive-image cohorts. Image capacity is recorded in raw runs (Pulumi 8 GiB; other workloads 16–32 GiB). Creation excludes subsequent first-status cost, which is reported separately in the details.

OpenClaw remains pinned at 410c0dda40702e25263b49b8b7d0786a5e49e366 with text=auto eol=lf attributes unchanged. Pulumi docs uses the full-history object store at 430261138aa08539cd598b9269bfe8f82fd49b78 with its markdown eol=lf rules unchanged. No application code or dependencies from either project were executed.

The frozen executable implements the final regular-file verifier at source 2dabb9c before the version-only release bump and still reports 0.3.0. It is not the published v0.3.0 binary. Source IDs, binary SHA-256 values, input pins and complete provenance accompany the raw results. Exact source commits for both campaigns are retained in candidate-sources.bundle, based on public commit c4e85fb.

The issue-5 comparison additionally retains six pre-optimization Twig creates. All 18 issue-5 measured creates verified successfully. The reporter's two-minute baseline was not reproduced on this Mac; the local before/after comparison is not proof that the reporter had the same bottleneck. See its generated summary and raw runs.

The final harness has a separately hashed recovery for Git's partial Directory-not-empty cleanup of benchmark-owned disposable warmup fixtures. It runs outside measurement, records each recovery and verifies registration cleanup before the allocation baseline. No failed measured operation is silently retried.

The initial pre-optimization 3,780-create campaign and its failed setup attempts remain archived under bench/results/2026-11-16-apfs; November 15 results remain under 2026-11-15-real. Neither is silently overwritten or used as the optimized candidate's headline timing. See the final campaign manifest and completion record, plus the separate issue-5 manifest and summary.
